description: one toilet, one sink, one mirror with a corners-of-the-room blur of grime the cleaner gave up on years ago. the hand dryer sounds like a dying engine. someone has scratched 'run' into the stall door with no further elaboration.

items.description: two stalls separated by a painted metal divider, one with a door that no longer latches. on the back of the unlatched door is a lengthy complaint about the dipping sauce, written in three colors.
items.name: stalls

items.description: a single porcelain sink with a dripping handle and an automatic soap dispenser that whirs on its own when you walk past. under the counter, half-hidden, a bucket of mop water from a shift ago.
items.name: sink

items.description: a metal hand dryer bolted to the wall that takes a full eight seconds to decide it's going to start. the top vent is plugged with a folded napkin.
items.name: hand dryer

name: Taco Bell Men's Restroom

exits.description: a beige hollow-core door with the universal stick-figure, paint chipped at the push plate.
